question:
From the 3 sets of statements, A, B and C given below, choose the set/s in which the third statement is a logical conclusion of the first two statements.

A. Some cars are Suzuki. All Suzukis are MPVs. Some cars are MPVs.

B. All men are humans. No human is red. No man is red.

C. Every man loves his wife. All wives are beautiful. No beautiful has a husband.
